actors.why: One row per actor keyed by id with name and gender; roles points at it.

directors.why: One row per director keyed by id with name; movies_directors and directors_genres point at it.

directors_genres.why: Links a director to a genre with a prob weight on the link; genre is a code with no table of its own.

movies.why: One row per film keyed by id with name, year and rank; roles, movies_directors and movies_genres point at it.

movies_directors.why: Pure link of director_id and movie_id, the pair its key.

movies_genres.why: Links a movie to genre codes, (movie_id, genre) its key; genre has no table of its own.

roles.why: Links actors to movies with the role played on the link; no time column.
